subject: NimbleCart checkout 503s — request for downtime validation and RCA scheduling
messages:
From: NimbleCart Ops <ops@nimblecart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout errors and 503s observed - possible service gap

Jonas —

We saw a spike of 503s impacting the /v1/checkout endpoint in our production tenant this morning between 2028-06-05T10:35:00Z and 2028-06-05T10:57:00Z (US-West customers affected). Error rate peaked at ~18% for 22 minutes; attached is a small sample of request IDs and a tail of proxy logs (nimblecart_sample_503s.log).

Customer tickets started coming in at 10:37Z; the retry surface caused user-visible drop in conversions. Can you please confirm whether this window qualifies as a usable downtime window under our SLA and whether Redwood will provide the raw telemetry/trace bundle required for our incident report?

We'd like:
- A confirmation of any Redwood-side routing or infra event in that exact UTC window
- A copy of the raw traces / token-level request timeline for 10:30Z–11:00Z (sample request IDs attached)
- A proposed time for an RCA meeting (we’re available Wed/Thu afternoon PT)

Thanks,
Maya Cortez
Ops Lead, NimbleCart
ops@nimblecart.com
Attachment: nimblecart_sample_503s.log (text, 48 KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: NimbleCart Ops <ops@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and 503s observed - possible service gap

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the alert and the log sample. We’ll treat this as an incident and begin evidence collection. Quick answers up front:
- We will validate whether the 10:35–10:57Z interval meets the SLA downtime criteria and share the computed availability window.
- We can pull the raw traces and telemetry for the request IDs you attached — we just need written permission to include request/trace data in the postmortem bundle (see note below).

Karthik (engineering) — can you triage for routing/fallback events in us-west-2 and pull any relay/connection failures that line up with NimbleCart’s timestamps?
Laura (AM) — I’ll loop you in on the credit-path conversation; NimbleCart may request proportional credit per the signed SLA.

Maya — to accelerate: please confirm one of these RCA slots (all PT): Wed 6/6 14:00–15:00, Wed 6/6 15:30–16:30, Thu 6/7 13:00–14:00. Also confirm we have permission to include 3rd-party and proxy logs in our internal bundle. We’ll attach an initial triage doc once Karthik has a look.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and 503s observed - possible service gap

Jonas / Laura —

Initial triage notes (attached: initial-triage.txt):
- I see a cluster of connection preemptions and an increase in backend retry latency from our us-west-2 relief pool starting ~10:34Z, with KV cache misses spiking at 10:36Z.
- There are a handful of GRPC stream resets tied to a transient routing table refresh on the edge plane; these correlate with some of the request IDs Maya sent.
- No automatic rollback or deploy was observed in that window.

Next steps I plan to run (ETA 4–6 hours):
1) Pull full trace slices for attached request IDs and cross-check token-level timing vs. our acceptance window.
2) Retrieve autoscaler and routing controller logs for 10:20Z–11:10Z.
3) Produce a candidate downtime interval (start/end, affected zones) and a short technical summary for customer.

If you want me to include Dedicated pool fallback decision logs (for customers with reserved capacity), say so — I can include them but it adds a small delay.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: initial-triage.txt

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and 503s observed - possible service gap

Maya —

Thanks again for the sample. Karthik has started evidence collection; we’ll deliver an initial tech summary and a proposed downtime interval within ~6 hours. Please note:

What you’ll get from Redwood:
- A timestamped availability calculation for 10:30Z–11:00Z with the candidate downtime start/end and per-zone impact.
- Raw trace slices and relay logs for the request IDs you provided (we’ll redact any PII per our data handling policy).
- A short explanation of the root-cause signals we observe (routing refresh + KV cache miss pattern).
- A preliminary credit estimate: per the NimbleCart SLA (section 4.2), proportional credit is calculated by prorating the uptime delta for the affected billing period. We’ll share the numeric for your review once the window is finalized.

We need your written permission to include your proxy logs + request IDs in our internal evidence bundle and to share the bundle with NimbleCart stakeholders. Reply with the wording: “Redwood: permission granted to pull and include logs and traces for the 2028-06-05 incident.” That will speed delivery.

Proposed RCA slots (PT):
- Wed 6/6 14:00–15:00
- Wed 6/6 15:30–16:30
- Thu 6/7 13:00–14:00

If none work, suggest a couple times and we’ll adjust.

Regards,
Jonas
